default_byte_identity.why_the_file_hash_moves: core.flight.FlightRuntime._phase_seed_inputs binds the implementation sha256 of rails.kb_policy, rails.knowledge_provider, rails.phase_supply, rails.knowledge_stores and core.flight.runtime. This change edits three of them, so every prepared artifact in the repository becomes stale and must be re-minted by its cell's own re-pin. That is the designed behaviour, not a side effect of this cell.

arithmetic: ceiling at conversion 1.0 = 70 x 0.041615 + 0 x 0.038525 = 2.9131 pp SLU-F1
conversion = persuasion 0.5 (UNMEASURED) x P(correct | covered) 0.9358 (measured, an upper bound: 889 of 950) = 0.4679

conversion_rate.status: ONE MEASURED FACTOR (an upper bound) TIMES ONE UNMEASURED FACTOR. The unmeasured one is the whole unknown.
conversion_rate.why_this_value: P(correct | covered) is measured at 889 of 950 covered Fold A rows, an upper bound. The persuasion factor is the midpoint of [0, 1], the only interval any evidence bounds; it is not reverse-engineered from any admission bar and it is deliberately not the ceiling. Perception already holds the full 60-label inventory in its task contract, so this change argues for an intent rather than admitting one -- which is why the persuasion factor cannot be inferred from the coverage counts.

expected_effect_derivation.honest_statement: DELIVERY IS NOT CORRECTNESS. Every measured quantity above is a count of rows that would RECEIVE their own gold intent's boundary entry; not one of them is a count of rows that would then ANSWER correctly. The conversion between the two is unmeasured, so the declared expected_effect_pp is a construction. It is stated at the midpoint conversion and is reported beside its own ceiling and its whole sweep. It is not a prediction, it is not evidence, and it must not be read as either.

already_delivered_and_still_intent_wrong.what_it_bounds: the only directly observable conversion evidence on this population, and it is zero: every row in this group receives the gold intent's boundary entry and is intent-wrong anyway

measured_inputs.where_the_gain_lands: ALL 70 of the intent-wrong delivery gain lands on INTENT-UNCOVERED -- the coverage-failure class, the only class a coverage repair can act on -- 70 of its 130 rows (53.8 %). INTENT-COVERED is a 2-for-2 wash, correctly, because delivery was never the binding constraint there. Only 4 rows in the whole 1,080-row roster lose delivery and all four are inside INTENT-COVERED. The arithmetic below therefore charges the change only against the class it actually moves.

measurement_design.canonical_declaration: docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-agree-w1-fold-a-v1/registered-facts-v1.json, top-level 'stage3_measurement' -- the block scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py resolves. The same block is repeated in the preregistration's fenced json for readability; the registered-facts copy has precedence.
measurement_design.if_it_does_not_clear: Reported, never engineered around. The honest options are: accept that the read may be NEUTRAL by width and treat the measured conversion as the cell's deliverable; or measure the conversion first on a smaller probe and re-declare. Inflating expected_effect_pp to clear the bar would be the one move this registration refuses.
measurement_design.why_an_in_chain_replicate: Rule 4 of the measurement instrument refuses a cross-flight contrast with no in-chain replicate outright; the A/A cell is that replicate and flies in the same campaign chain.
measurement_design.why_not_offline_sealed_pool: The effect is a change to what Perception CONSUMES, so it cannot be read off a sealed pool: no sealed sample was produced under the new ranking. The GPU is the only instrument for it.

recall_width_correction.consequence: The two arms differ in w_agree ALONE, which makes the A/A a genuine one-factor control rather than only a replicate.

the_widening_is_a_no_op_on_its_own.claim: At pure cosine the top 8 of a 60-wide recall IS the 8-wide recall's set, in the same order, so the delivered selection does not move.
the_widening_is_a_no_op_on_its_own.measured_beside_it: the production replication reads the baseline at width 60 as bit-identical to width 8 (45.0 % / 97.3 % on Fold A), and the delivered-width histograms are byte-identical between the two arms, so the read's +1.4 tokens per row holds
the_widening_is_a_no_op_on_its_own.proof: The in-chain A/A control carries k = 60 at w_agree 0.0 and its own prepared first-phase supply reproduces the sealed comparator's output digest ba5e1faab9550fcae700f649a0ec6674327ffefe97d7044bb7ea3887536fb54f exactly on all 1,080 rows.

recall_width_correction.what_is_registered: w_agree 1.0, DELIVERED width left at 8 (fuse_coverage m 8 / c 1 / top_l 8), RECALL width k moved from 8 to 60
recall_width_correction.why: PhaseSupplySpec.k is top_k_per_dimension: the recall truncates by cosine before the ranker runs, so at k = 8 the agreement term can only permute the eight the cosine already chose. Measured through the production path: at k = 8 wrong-row delivery is 45.0 % -> 45.0 % on all three rosters -- the treatment is INERT. The read's own simulation recalled at 60 and delivered 8.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-AGREE-AA-FOLD-A-V1.note: The A/A replicate is the INSTRUMENT, not a claim: it re-flies the locked plan's own form so the AGREE delta is read against a within-chain null. Its expected effect is exactly zero by construction, and a non-zero read on it is a measurement of the instrument, which is what it is for.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-AGREE-W1-FOLD-A-SMOKE-.note: Four rows prove FORM and nothing else: that the agreement table loads and hash-verifies, that the boundary channel still delivers eight entries, that every request fits and that the episode completes. Scored by no one, read by no one; under the measurement instrument's rule 5 a batch of four rows can never be evidence of benefit.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-AGREE-W1-FOLD-A-V1.note: Cell AGREE claims a benefit and is the first cell of this programme to do so on well-evidenced grounds. The expectation is DERIVED, not guessed: the measured newly-delivered row counts per bad-case class times that class's measured perfect-repair headroom, times a STATED conversion of 0.467895 that is UNMEASURED. Delivery is not correctness; the conversion is the cell's own primary unknown, and the declared number is a construction, not a prediction. Ceiling at conversion 1.0 is 2.9131 pp, so this design's 2.5 pp admission bar at n = 1,080 is NOT cleared by the declared expectation -- reported, not engineered around.
